what: The LIVE Alpaca 1h fetch has NO 429 backoff. MEASURED 2026-11-06T02:29-02:31Z (RQ-20261106-d5a1-01 pass 2, run 42145318852, paper key pair, iex feed): one sequential unpaced pass of AlpacaMarketData.get_ohlcv(symbol, '1h', limit=400) over the 173 a41f ETFs took 62.9 s, made 217 HTTP calls, 104 returned 429, and 82 of 173 symbols came back with NO bars (pass 1, paced, found only 2 symbols without bars, so ~80 empties are 429 losses). Root cause: _bars_paged re-raises a first-page HTTPError and get_ohlcv's except returns None, so a rate-limited symbol is silently skipped for that tick. Not urgent at today's Alpaca roster size (alpaca_paper ~14 ETFs + ml_entry's 13), but any widening (the operator's ml_entry baseline on alpaca_live over the a41f population) would lose roughly half its symbols every tick, and the shared paper key means a burst also starves alpaca_paper's own fetch. Fix: bounded backoff on 429/5xx in _bars_paged (Retry-After, else 2**attempt capped), plus pacing across the tick's Alpaca symbols, mirroring scripts/research/alpaca_readonly.py. Tier 2 (order-path data fetch).
